# powerhmc_vios_install (Action)

Performs VIOS installation on a managed system. Supports only installation type **image** (local HMC repository installation) — the VIOS image must first be imported into the HMC local repository. Once imported, provide the image directory name via the `image_source` attribute.

Actions are invoked by declaring an `action "powerhmc_vios_install" "<name>" { config { ... } }` block and triggering it at a resource lifecycle event with a `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` block on that resource. Actions require Terraform v1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Install VIOS onto a partition from an image already staged on the HMC.
# The installation image must exist on the HMC at:
#   /extra/viosimages/<image_source>/<image_name>.iso
action "powerhmc_vios_install" "install" {
  config {
    system_name       = "Server-9009-22A-SN123456"
    vios_name         = "vios1"
    profile_name      = "default_profile"
    installation_type = "image"              # only "image" is supported
    image_source      = "installation_image" # directory name under /extra/viosimages/

    # Network configuration for the installation path.
    ip_address  = "10.0.0.60"
    subnet_mask = "255.255.255.0"
    gateway     = "10.0.0.1"
    boot_device = "U78AE.001.WZS0225-P1-C18-L1-T1" # adapter location code

    # Optional tuning.
    speed          = "1000" # "10" | "100" | "1000"
    duplex_mode    = "full" # "auto" | "full" | "half"
    vlan_tag       = 0      # 0-4094
    vlan_priority  = 0      # 0-7
    tftp_retries   = 5      # 0-9
    bootp_retries  = 5      # 0-9
    timeout        = 150    # minutes, at least 30
    license_accept = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `boot_device` (String) Adapter location code for the boot device (e.g., `U78AE.001.WZS0225-P1-C18-L1-T1` or `C18-L1-T1`)
- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP address
- `ip_address` (String) IP address for the VIOS client
- `subnet_mask` (String) Subnet mask for the network configuration
- `system_name` (String) Name of the managed system where VIOS will be installed
- `vios_name` (String) Name of the VIOS partition to install

### Optional

- `bootp_retries` (Number) BOOTP retry count. Range: 0-9. Defaults to `5`.
- `duplex_mode` (String) Network adapter duplex mode. Valid values: `auto` (default), `full`, `half`.
- `hmc_host_network_interface` (String) Optional HMC host network interface to use for the VIOS installation network path.
- `image_source` (String) Required when `installation_type` is `image`. Provide the directory name only (e.g., `installation_image`); the full path is resolved internally as `/extra/viosimages/{image_source}/<image_name>.iso`.
- `installation_type` (String) Type of installation. Only `image` is supported. Defaults to `image`.
- `license_accept` (Boolean) Whether to automatically accept the VIOS license after installation. Defaults to `true`.
- `profile_name` (String) Profile name for the VIOS partition. Defaults to `default_profile`.
- `speed` (String) Network adapter speed. Valid values: `10`, `100`, `1000`. Defaults to `auto`.
- `tftp_retries` (Number) TFTP retry count. Range: 0-9. Defaults to `5`.
- `timeout` (Number) Installation operation timeout in minutes. Must be at least 30. Defaults to `150` minutes.
- `vlan_priority` (Number) VLAN tag priority. Range: 0-7. Defaults to `0`.
- `vlan_tag` (Number) VLAN tag identifier. Range: 0-4094. Defaults to `0` (no VLAN).

## Notes

- `image_source` is required when `installation_type = image` (the only supported type).
- The installation image must already exist on the HMC at `/extra/viosimages/{image_source}/<image_name>.iso`.
- `speed` here accepts only `10|100|1000` (no `auto`), and `timeout` must be at least 30 minutes.
- When installing VIOS on multiple partitions in the same configuration, set `parallelism = 1` in your `terraform apply` command (e.g., `terraform apply -parallelism=1`) to ensure installations run sequentially and do not interfere with each other.
